digest.overview: Apple and OpenAI escalate their trade-secrets lawsuit with public counter-claims and leaked messages. Local inference sees rapid progress on DeepSeek V4 Flash across single-GPU, Mac, and server setups, plus new small open models from Mistral and Liquid AI. Community mood mixes legal drama with excitement over cheaper, faster on-device AI.

top_story.headline: Apple-OpenAI lawsuit turns public as OpenAI publishes internal messages
top_story.summary: Apple widens its probe claiming more ex-employees took confidential hardware data to OpenAI; OpenAI responds overnight with a blog post titled 'Apple is getting this wrong' and publishes messages suggesting Apple continued seeking help from a departed engineer.
top_story.why_it_matters: The public airing of receipts raises stakes in the high-profile trade-secrets case and highlights ongoing talent and IP friction between the two companies.

sentiment.label: mixed
sentiment.summary: Legal tension between Apple and OpenAI dominates discussion while local-inference wins and new small models generate optimism about accessible AI.

model_releases.headline: Mistral releases Shieldstral 3B multimodal safety classifier
model_releases.summary: Open-weights 3B model outperforms models up to 7x larger on safety classification tasks.

model_releases.headline: Liquid AI ships LFM2.5-2.6B for local agents
model_releases.summary: New small model targets deployable agents everywhere via Hugging Face.

frontier_labs.headline: NVIDIA-backed Open Secure AI Alliance releases SAFE guidelines RFC
frontier_labs.summary: 120+ organizations contribute cybersecurity transparency rules for agentic AI ahead of Black Hat.

frontier_labs.headline: Apple expands OpenAI trade-secrets investigation in court filing
frontier_labs.summary: Claims additional former employees may have retained confidential data.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: Given today, it is surprising how daring Microsoft & Google were initially with AI. Microsoft released GPT-4 before OpenAI, didn't back down after Sydney & got Copilot to market quickly... Google dealt with blowback about Bard and AI Overview and invented deep research.
influencer_takes.context: Reflects on early corporate risk-taking in AI amid current legal and competitive caution.

influencer_takes.author: Ethan Mollick
influencer_takes.quote: An unexpectedly stress-reducing use of Codex/Code is just fixing problems with my various Windows machines: weird driver issues, game incompatibilities...
influencer_takes.context: Highlights practical, under-appreciated wins from coding agents.

research_radar.headline: Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale
research_radar.summary: First large-scale analysis of multi-step LLM agent workloads vs. chatbots on GitHub Copilot data.

post_ideas.hook: OpenAI just dropped receipts on Apple in the trade-secrets fight
post_ideas.draft: OpenAI published internal messages showing Apple kept pinging a former engineer for help weeks after he left. The lawsuit just got messier and more public.
post_ideas.why_viral: Live legal drama between two AI giants with direct quotes creates instant shareable tension.

post_ideas.hook: DeepSeek V4 Flash hitting 15+ tps decode on a single 5090 with 1M context
post_ideas.draft: One RTX 5090 + vLLM offloading now runs full 1M context DeepSeek V4 Flash at usable speeds for agentic coding. Local frontier is closing fast.
post_ideas.why_viral: Concrete hardware numbers on a consumer card surprise readers expecting cloud-only performance.

post_ideas.hook: Mistral just dropped a 3B safety model that beats 7x larger ones
post_ideas.draft: Shieldstral is a 3B open-weights multimodal safety classifier outperforming models up to 21B. Small specialized models keep punching above their weight.
post_ideas.why_viral: Underdog size + benchmark win plays into the ongoing open vs closed and small vs large debate.
